text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CLINK!*)

text_block_list.name: A Certain Hero
text_block_list.text:
...! How could you...!
To shield me and take the blade yourself...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Sage
text_block_list.text: "I merely deflected it with my shield. For it is my wish to forever protect and understand you."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Hero
text_block_list.text: (...What profound sincerity. I wish to repay his devotion. If there is anything I can do—)

text_block_list.name: A Certain Hero
text_block_list.text:
“—Take this. It is one of the gems adorning my sword.
I want you to accept it as a token of my gratitude.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Because I wish to forever be
the one who protects and understands you...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (You're kind of... like my Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, I need to show my gratitude through my actions too.
Just like this hero...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day. The Umamusume passing by were all giving or receiving presents.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking how heartwarming it was,
I walked around the academy for a while until—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling eyes on me from somewhere, I whipped around on reflex.
choice_data_list: Huh, Rob Roy? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...!!!!
U-Um, well... you see...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As a token of my gratitude, th-the adornment of my sword,
th-th-the pre-precious... j-jeweled...
No, wait, not that!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...Aargh, I bit my tongue!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! It's nothing!
E-Excuse me...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What could have happened? Zenno Rob Roy left for
somewhere before finishing what she was saying.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, several hours later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy between tasks,
I felt eyes on me once again, so when I turned around—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! By the way, um—
there's something I wanted to talk to you about...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A-Actually, this is it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Zenno Rob Roy brandished a replica sword.
It's crafted so meticulously you'd mistake it for the real thing,
and it looks like it has serious heft to it...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, well... you see, this is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――WHOOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Kyaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A sudden gust blew, and the sword Zenno Rob Roy was holding tumbled down, plunging deep into the ground...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaaahh!!?
I-I didn't mean to--!!
Pardon meeeeeeeeee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something's off with Zenno Rob Roy today...
I need to have a proper talk with her next time we meet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, having finished the day's work,
just as I put my hand on the Trainer's Room door to head home—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I bumped into Zenno Rob Roy again—!
Instinctively, I glance at both of her hands.
It seems... there is no sword."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry about earlier!!
I-It's okay! I don't have my sword anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"However... um—
you're heading home now, right...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy tried to back away.
I hastily reached out a hand to stop her.
I still haven't heard what she had to say.
choice_data_list: Wait! Don't you have something else to do?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: T-That's, um—
choice_data_list: It's okay, I just want to listen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Gently staying by my side—
just like that wise sage..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Um... well.
...Would you listen to a story of mine?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, she told me a story.
A tale of a certain hero and sage."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...The wise one said they always wished to be the hero's greatest guardian and closest confidant.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The hero also showed gratitude through actions—by handing over the jewel embedded in their own sword.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"So I was thinking that I'd like to show my daily gratitude
through my actions too..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, I do regret going too far by bringing out a replica sword, but...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Running away after coming this far
isn't what a hero does... Ngh, so—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“—Take this. It is one of the gems that adorns my sword.
Please accept it as a token of my gratitude.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Nnngh!!
I've done it now...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah...!!
F-For someone like me to do something so presumptuous...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? Um, yes...!!
Th-Thank you so much...!!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The taste is pretty ordinary, though...
They're just standard truffles shaped like cobbles, after all...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't expect too much as you eat it...!!
P-Please enjoy...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, I ate the truffles I received in my room.
Made with such devoted care,
they had a truly heartwarming flavor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I received a present from Zenno Rob Roy.
It looks like there's a handwritten message card inside—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaaahhh...!!?
Pl-Please wait!!!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I, um, never expected
you to read it right in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... it's too embarrassing here...!!
Could you please read it when you're alone?!
choice_data_list: Got it, if that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Th-Thank you very much.
Well then... have a happy Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Zenno Rob Roy,
I decided to take my time reading the card in my room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This is a little side story to the epic tale.
A story to convey feelings to the other protagonist."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "My sword and your shield are two parts of a single whole. I pray that beside the sword I wield, your shield will always be there."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—From a fledgeling hero, to a beloved sage."
